name: ladders
notes: Structural gates over the two imported stores before certification — the point-in-time ledger (stream predexon_l2_pit, from source-pit-ladders.json) and the settled-markets table (stream markets, from source-settled-markets.json). Structure only: a row that ARRIVES with its keys, a lawful settlement vocabulary, prices inside [0, 1]. Whether a book is usable is the pipeline's call (pmquant-ladder-source recomputes it from the ladders), never a suite's — the vocabulary here is restated on purpose, so an assertion never reads its expectation from the thing it validates.

rules.notes: An empty ledger import is a wrong path or an empty store, never a quiet session.
Every decision epoch belongs to a contract; the reader keys on it.
The event is the independence unit of every split and every bootstrap cluster.
Two epoch kinds exist; anything else is a writer defect.
A book dated after it was acquired cannot be point-in-time.
One row per contract; a duplicate means two stores were merged without dedup.
Settled contracts read yes/no; an open one carries the empty string. The settlement reader refuses anything else by name.
The three rung geometries; the ladder type is classified from them.
Quotes are dollar probabilities; a value outside [0, 1] is a unit slip upstream.
